candidates.change_summary: Shift right by 0x60 bits (truncation to address) replaced with shift right by 0x00 (no truncation), returning full 32-byte calldata value.
Change argument offset from 0x0 to 0x14, reading the collateral address instead of owner address.
Change argument offset from 0x0 to 0x28, reading the debt token address instead of owner address.
Change argument offset from 0x0 to 0x3c, reading the factory address instead of owner address.
Replace _getArgAddress(0x0) with _getArgAddress(0x0) bitwise-AND with 0 (always returns address(0)).
Replace _getArgAddress(0x0) with address(msg.sender), which reads the caller address instead of immutable args.
Change the returned ERC20 address from _getArgAddress(0x14) to _getArgAddress(0x28) so that collateral() returns the debt token address instead.
Change the returned ERC20 address from _getArgAddress(0x14) to _getArgAddress(0x0) so that collateral() returns the owner address cast to ERC20.
Change the returned ERC20 address from _getArgAddress(0x14) to _getArgAddress(0x3c) so that collateral() returns the factory address cast to ERC20.
Change the return expression to return the collateral token address instead of the debt token address.
Change the return expression to return the factory address instead of the debt token address.
Change the return expression to return a hardcoded zero address instead of the debt token address.
